nodes.label: Phase A - Core Platform
nodes.rationale: Foundation milestone: Next.js frontend + Express backend established with typing test and history APIs before layering learning and gamification features.

nodes.label: Phase C - Auth Integration
nodes.rationale: Unify frontend sessions (NextAuth) with backend API authorization via a token bridge so protected API route patterns are standardized.

nodes.label: Authentication Feature
nodes.rationale: Dual auth model: NextAuth (Credentials + Google provider) session in the frontend bridged to a backend JWT via /api/v1/auth/token for API authorization.

nodes.label: Typing Test Feature
nodes.rationale: Core timed tests at /dashboard with WPM/accuracy metrics and result history persisted via /tests and /tests/stats APIs.

nodes.label: TypeMaster Platform
nodes.rationale: Monorepo typing platform combining real-time typing tests (/dashboard), progressive lesson flow (/learn), minigames (/games), achievements and progress analytics (/achievements, /progress).

nodes.label: Monorepo Architecture Stack
nodes.rationale: Split UI, API, and data across a Next.js App Router frontend (apps/frontend), Express API backend (apps/backend/src/index.ts), Prisma ORM (apps/backend/prisma/schema.prisma) over PostgreSQL, with NextAuth in the frontend and backend JWT Bearer tokens for API authorization.

nodes.label: Phase D - Hardening
nodes.rationale: In-progress phase: tighten JWT verification and user-scope checks; remaining quality/security backlog is tracked in CODEBASE_AUDIT.md.

nodes.label: Documentation Update Policy
nodes.rationale: Keep documentation implementation-backed: update docs in the same PR as behavior changes and keep route/API references tied to actual source files, live environment variables, and hosting.

nodes.label: Backend Bootstrap Middleware Stack
nodes.rationale: Centralize security and request handling at server bootstrap: helmet, CORS allowlist from env, JSON/body parsing, a global rate limiter, API mounts under /api/v1, and a centralized error handler.

nodes.label: Security Posture Notes
nodes.rationale: CORS allowlist sourced from CORS_ORIGINS/CORS_ORIGIN env vars plus globally enabled rate limiting that is stricter on auth routes reduce attack surface; known gaps tracked in CODEBASE_AUDIT.md.

nodes.label: Vercel/Render Deployment Flow
nodes.rationale: Production frontend runs on Vercel (typemaster-chirag.vercel.app); next.config.js rewrites /api/v1/* to the backend URL, falling back to the Render URL when NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is unset so the deployed UI always reaches the hosted API.

nodes.label: Build Strictness Caveat
nodes.rationale: next.config.js sets eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds=true and typescript.ignoreBuildErrors=true, allowing builds with lint/type issues; disable both for stricter CI that fails builds on errors.

nodes.label: Gemini Client-Side Key Exposure Risk
nodes.rationale: AI feedback currently calls Gemini directly from the client using NEXT_PUBLIC_GEMINI_API_KEY; move this behind a backend proxy to avoid key exposure.

nodes.label: Local Setup Workflow
nodes.rationale: Ordered steps (install, configure env, prepare database, start dev servers, validate) so contributors reach a running stack deterministically.
